mentions.name: vet
mentions.description: An open source package vetting tool that automates security analysis of dependencies, going beyond CVE matching to identify code capabilities, malicious code, and other security-sensitive attributes through code analysis.
mentions.problem: Package vetting today relies mainly on CVE data and misses malicious code and other security-sensitive attributes present in open source dependencies.
mentions.source_excerpt: Building vet. The goal is to automate open source package vetting beyond just CVE but actually identify code capabilities, malicious code and other security sensitive attributes through code analysis.
